scope: Sensor development, same unmodified sided print, 70 degree native HD. No action or confirmation with a failed observer.
hypothesis: A same-bank colour transition has a material vertex only where it meets an actual inner lip (positive through depth) or the expected contralateral ink of a surviving central triangle. The most inboard shared-colour pixel by itself is not such a junction.
boundary: For each row 1..12 on BOTH banks, look for a directly supported three-region junction in pixel-centre geometry. Follow the boundary between the two adjacent row colours. Intersect its local line with an observed lip edge, or with the expected intact opposite ink. Only near-surface colour contacts or a finite background at least 2 mm behind the bank are permitted. Require consistent contact orientation toward the other bank, a visible local transition, and identifiable intersection; parallel, multiple incompatible, completely hidden or unresolved junctions abstain. Recover depth on the material bank, not in the hole. Do not use the other bank to invent a corner, the camera pose, the request, a staged cut length, file IDs, simulator nodes or prior values in the reader. The original downstream face/open/local/3D/guard predicates and the entire previous development gate remain binding. Missing one side is not a complete boundary.
min_screen: On each of the 8-mm and 9-mm registered CLOSED 3-mm look frames, both depth variants must localize all four endpoints of the last fully open cell (two rows x two sides), Euclidean camera-coordinate error strictly below 0.5 mm at every point, two positively separated faces under the unchanged predicate, and same-frame tool passing the inherited pose bounds. Score each corner separately (no averaging, no dropping missing). Also report work and 10-mm look separately. Score all full-readout candidates on ALL 20 pre-existing exposures as in the parent. The small corner screen is not a stop or continuation verdict.
failure_attribution: After predictions have been sealed, compare the projection of each reference node to the closest directly observed same-bank a/b pixel contact and each adjacent ordinal's direct contact with behind-depth. Separately check local projected row length and whether the reference vertex is itself visible or covered, using pixel-neighbourhood diagnostics only. Classifier never sees these measurements. Do not tune thresholds against the scored real labels.
conditional: Do not change control or guards, collect confirmation, or start M5 if any minimum or parent gate fails. If only 10 mm fails, follow the parent 50-degree registration rule, not a synthetic crop. With passing development, require independent matched controls (half-cell, bridge and causal connected prefix, current tool/fresh geometry before closure), then full live runs. One safe rejection is not a successful run.

live_acceptance.per_scenario: Start at independently measured 0. Every closure needs visual alignment, current scissors pose and finite guard; recover a new visible slit after each bite, also after recovery actions. Zero actions on UNKNOWN. No stale or privileged cut progress. Independently scored structural prefix 9..10 mm inclusive, no affected row beyond 10 (also report actual excess over 9), zero tears/faults, measured closed at stop and after withdraw, measured ready within 0.5 mm / 1 degree. Tagged truth strict=True throughout and purpose log verified; intervention must actually be exercised. Never count a truth-driven collection or a skipped run as a success.
